notes: 2 section headers — too few for a contents list.

decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 2 headings sit at a level the page never opens — "State Administrators" is an h3 with no h2 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 2 headings are plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Write the email addresses the same way
decisions.why: 5 addresses are shown in whatever case it was typed in. The house form capitalises each name and leaves a middle initial in lower case — Gary.A.Lewis@maine.gov → Gary.a.Lewis@maine.gov. Only the first letter of each part changes, so a name that spells itself LaBreck keeps doing so.

decisions.label: Make a loose address look like an address
decisions.why: 7 email addresses sit in the body of this page rather than in a contact block, drawn exactly like every other link — so the one that opens a mail window looks the same as the ones that go to web pages. The chip carries the same envelope the banner's contact link uses. The address itself does not change.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
decisions.why: It repeats the page title in picture form, which the new banner already does in type.
